result.rationale: The migration unconditionally indexes the first row of the embed_category query result: `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']`. If the site never set embed_category (its prior default was '' per the removed site_settings.yml `embed_category: ''`), no site_settings row exists and `[0]` will be nil/raise, aborting the migration. The mechanism is visible in the diff and plausible on default installs.
